proposed_widenings.name: SkillFilter.build_time_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: SkillFilter.choice is documented and designed for per-activation cast-time choices (Guidance: 'you choose a skill at cast time'). Scholar's skill selection is a permanent build-time decision made once when the feature is acquired. A timing discriminant or a distinct 'build_time_choice' variant is needed to represent this correctly without semantic leakage into per-activation choice logic.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following skills in which you have proficiency: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion. You have Expertise in the chosen skill.

proposed_widenings.name: ProficiencyFilter prerequisite
proposed_widenings.justification: The SRD requires the chosen skill to be one 'in which you have proficiency.' The current surface has no mechanism to express a prerequisite constraint limiting build-time choices to skills the character already has proficiency in. The 6-option list is encoded, but the proficiency pre-requirement is omitted.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following skills in which you have proficiency: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion.

notes: Encoding typechecks and traces without error. The mechanical effect of Expertise (double PB on skill checks) is correctly approximated as a passive modify_roll_numeric +PB delta scoped to the chosen skill, since the character already has +PB from proficiency. The skillFilter.choice with 6 options encodes the option set. Primary gap: SkillFilter.choice is documented as a per-activation cast-time primitive (Guidance), while Scholar's choice is a one-time build-time pick — these have different resolution semantics. Secondary gap: 'in which you have proficiency' prerequisite constraint is dropped.
